title: OpenCV in Computer Vision: A Practical Intermediate Course
description: A balanced, hands-on journey through classical computer vision with OpenCV in Python — from image fundamentals to feature matching, video analysis, and a touch of deep-learning integration.

modules.title: Foundations of OpenCV and Digital Images
modules.summary: Install OpenCV, internalise the BGR/uint8/HxWxC array model, and master pixel-level I/O, drawing, and arithmetic.

lessons.title: How Computers See: Pixels, Channels, and Color Spaces

modules.title: Image Processing Fundamentals
modules.summary: Reshape and clean images with affine and perspective transforms, smoothing filters, thresholding, and morphology.

modules.title: Edges, Gradients, and Contours
modules.summary: Bridge from per-pixel ops to image structure: gradients, edges, contours, shape descriptors, and histogram-based contrast.

lessons.title: Image Gradients with Sobel and Scharr

modules.title: Features, Keypoints, and Matching
modules.summary: Find repeatable keypoints, describe them with SIFT/ORB/AKAZE, match across images, and recover planar geometry with homographies.

lessons.title: Corner Detection with Harris and Shi-Tomasi
Keypoint Descriptors: SIFT, ORB, and AKAZE
Feature Matching with Brute-Force and FLANN

modules.title: Video, Motion, and Tracking
modules.summary: Add the time dimension: capture video, segment motion, estimate optical flow, and follow objects with built-in trackers.

lessons.title: Working with Video Streams and Webcams

modules.title: Applied Computer Vision and Modern Integrations
modules.summary: Apply the toolkit: Haar-cascade detection, camera calibration, a deep-learning bridge through cv2.dnn, and a capstone pipeline.

lessons.title: Bridging to Deep Learning with cv2.dnn
Capstone: Building a Mini Vision Pipeline
